meta.purpose: Stage 2 for the skincare retailers: the 3 that passed recon-003 get their whole catalog and 4 random GTIN probes; all 13 get product .js probes on overlap candidates drawn from the recon-002 catalogs at random within score bands 0.5-0.6, 0.6-0.7, 0.7-0.8 and 0.8+, so the precision of each cut-off can be checked against GTINs (D-002). At most 18 named probes per retailer.
